answer: Probe every identity at one unannounced moment. The economy sends a burst of fresh tasks to all keys at once, each due within a short window. An honest agent answers its own task alone, clear as crystal, but one operator behind a thousand keys must serve them all from the same compute, so replies come late, thin and in lockstep, like ripples in a lagoon from one stone. Keys that fail these simultaneous probes together, timing as regular as a quartz clock, get merged into one reward share.
